|strategy=By Martin Arlt<ref name="decipher-strategy">https://web.archive.org/web/20040811123219/http://www.decipher.com/starwars/cardlists/coruscant/light/small/radiantvii.html</ref>

This little ship brought [[Obi-Wan Kenobi{{!}}Obi-Wan]] and Qui-Gon to [[Naboo]], but it can do much more than that. For one thing, you never need to worry about drawing this ship into your hand, since the Used Interrupt [[We Wish To Board At Once]] will let you take the [[Radiant VII]] into your hand from the Reserve Deck. Once in your hand, you can use [[Squadron Assignments]] to deploy it with one of its matching pilots ([[Captain Madakor]] or [[Lieutenant Williams]]) with ease. Once Williams and Madakor are piloting the [[Radiant VII]], it is bumped up to 9 power and immunity to attrition less than 5. Add a third pilot like Ric Oli&eacute; to increase the ship's power to 12. In addition, if you have no other ships at the system, your opponent will be unable to draw more than one battle destiny here, and unless they have ability > 6, that destiny will be reduced by 3, making it difficult for the Dark Side to get this pesky little ship out of its sky.

Combos:

Now the [[Radiant VII]] has immunity to attrition &lt; 7, and all those Droid Starfighters are power -2.

If your opponent thinks he can wear you down with a couple of battleships, he should think again: now you're drawing three battle destiny!
